name: pblang
description: Language support for PBLang 4.2.0 (.sapp/.sap files) — Multi-file Workspace LSP 3.17, Algebraic Enum/Trait/Generic & SQL Injection Verifier, 9D SI/EUR Units, CAD/Presburger Contracts, Coverage HTML/JSON & Shrinking Fuzzer

commands.title: PBLang: Check Current File (SI Units, Contracts & SQL Safety)
PBLang: Generate Line & Branch Coverage Report (HTML/JSON)

pblang.serverPath.description: Executable path for the PBLang 4.2.0 runtime and LSP server.

pblang.strictMode.description: Enable strict gradual type checking alongside 9D SI/Currency dimensional analysis and algebraic enum/trait/generic checks.

pblang.verifyContracts.description: Prove or refute requires/ensures contracts at compile time using Tarski CAD and Cooper-Presburger.

pblang.strictSql.description: Treat unbounded SQL DELETE/UPDATE statements without WHERE or /* allow_full_table */ as compile-time errors.

pblang.lsp.inlayHints.description: Enable inline inlay hints for inferred 9D SI/Currency units, parameter names, verified SQL placeholders, and exhaustive matches.

pblang.lsp.useWorkspaceServerV42.description: Use the pure-PBLang v4.2 multi-file Workspace LSP server (cross-file definition, workspace rename/references, signatureHelp, and inlayHints).
